hero_heading: General Contractor in Elk Ridge, Utah
hero_subheading: American Legacy Contracting proudly serves Elk Ridge, the quiet mountain community perched above Salem and just a short drive from our home base in Payson. Elk Ridge homeowners expect a higher standard of craftsmanship to match their premium properties, and Alan Barben delivers exactly that with personalized attention, quality materials, and the kind of detail work that these custom homes deserve.
about_city: Elk Ridge is unlike anywhere else in south Utah County. Sitting at roughly 5,400 feet on a wooded ridge between Salem and Payson, this small community of around 4,000 residents offers panoramic valley views, larger lot sizes, and a pace of life that feels a world away from the busier cities below. The homes here reflect that distinction. Many are custom-built with vaulted ceilings, stone facades, expansive decks, and layouts designed to take advantage of the mountain setting. American Legacy Contracting understands the specific demands of building and renovating at elevation on Elk Ridge. We know the soil conditions, the steeper grades, and the premium finishes that homeowners on the ridge expect. Being based in Payson at the foot of the ridge means we're practically neighbors, and we treat every Elk Ridge project with the care and precision that these distinctive properties require.

local_services.title: Remodels & Renovations
local_services.description: Elk Ridge homes are built to impress, and renovations here need to meet that standard. Whether you're updating a kitchen with granite or quartz countertops, expanding a master suite to capture those valley views, or converting a dated great room into a modern open-concept living space, we deliver remodels that enhance the character and value of your ridge-top property.

local_services.title: Basement Finishing
local_services.description: Many Elk Ridge homes sit on sloped lots with walkout basements that offer incredible potential. We finish these lower levels into expansive family rooms, home gyms, guest suites, and entertainment spaces that take full advantage of the natural light and views that walkout designs provide. The result is usable square footage that feels like a natural extension of the main living areas, not an afterthought.

local_services.title: New Construction
local_services.description: Building on Elk Ridge comes with unique considerations: steeper terrain, specific setback requirements, and homeowners who want something truly custom. American Legacy Contracting builds homes designed for the ridge's topography and views, from site preparation on sloped lots to selecting exterior materials that complement the mountain surroundings.

local_services.title: Handyman Services
local_services.description: Mountain living means extra wear from weather, wildlife, and elevation. We handle deck repairs and re-staining, exterior trim replacement, window caulking for harsh winters, fence mending, and all the maintenance tasks that keep an Elk Ridge property looking sharp. Our proximity in Payson means quick turnaround without the trip charges that distant contractors tack on.
